name: Narrator
text: Kyra stirs, her eyelids fluttering open as she finds herself slouched in a worn, leather armchair. She looks around, disoriented

name: Kyra
text: How did I… end up here?

name: Kyra
text: I don’t remember sitting down neither getting abroad.. this.. weird old looking dark ship

name: Narrator
text: She rubs her temples, the faint memory of her mission coming back to her as she rises slowly.

name: Kyra
text: The mission... the signal. Scotland Yard sent me to investigate, but…

name: Kyra
text: My hands and feet can’t stop shaking..

name: Kyra
text: My mind and heart feel numb with paranoia and..

name: Kyra
text: with a dark energy I cannot yet comprehend its force or origins..
